entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I was going to buy an air conditioner,[n]but now that I'm actually here, I'm[n]having second thoughts.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I've never liked air conditioners much.[n]They make me too cold...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: But the hum of an electric fan bothers[n]me. It makes it so hard to concentrate[n]on my strategy books...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'm sorry I'm holding us up...
Take your time.[clr 27]
Go with your gut.
Why not both?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Still, I shouldn't indulge my indecisiveness[n]too much. That could turn into a terrible[n]weakness in shogi.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I shall try to reach an answer soon.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I can understand trusting your intuition,[n]but surely it deserves at least a little[n]forethought...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: A bold proposal. But... not exactly a[n]cost-effective one.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: [fName]? What a coincidence.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And she is...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm...? Where do I know her from...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You're Kitagawa-kun, from the art[n]track, yes? I'm Hifumi Togo... I go to[n]Kosei as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Togo... Ah, the professional shogi player...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm Yusuke Kitagawa. It's a pleasure[n]to meet you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Did you two also come to bask in the[n]cool air?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: No, he's helping me pick out an air[n]conditioner.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Kitagawa-kun, are you here because...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My dorm is a burning hellscape.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thus, the clear solution was to find a[n]place of more comfort, so that my[n]creativity might flow once more.
How frugal of you.
Good thinking.
Why not just strip?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I prefer to think of it as saving energy—[n]both my own, and the electrical. Is that[n]not sensible, [fName]?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Isn't it? Though I did decide not to[n]bring my art supplies, in the end.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, a most ingenious idea. But I fear[n]it wouldn't be wise to do so here...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My funds are wholly devoted to acquiring[n]more art supplies. Yet this interminable[n]heat has dulled my creative edge...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Here, I may enjoy the cooling breeze,[n]and find inspiration in next-generation[n]technology. What more could I ask for?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I see... You make a compelling case,[n]Kitagawa-kun.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Oh? So you understand as well, Togo-san?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: With a single swing, the blade of creativity[n]may cleave through all adversity.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Whether wielded in a painter's hand[n]or a tactician's, what's important is that[n]the blade is guided by righteous valor.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A bit eccentric, isn't she?
You're one to talk.
Kind of like you.
That's good, right?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Is something wrong, you two?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is that a compliment?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Is something wrong, you two?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You think so?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To have such a firm, personalized view[n]of the world... Yes, I daresay it's a[n]wonderful thing.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Is something wrong, you two?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No. Nothing in particular.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: By the way, Togo-san, have you settled[n]on an air conditioner?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: No, I'm trying to decide between an[n]air conditioner and an electric fan...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Between the two, I'd prefer an electric[n]fan, but the noise would still bother me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I did see an electric fan that functioned[n]with no blades. Perhaps that would[n]suffice?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: A bladeless fan?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I saw a tower fan where the tower was[n]hollow, yet air was still flowing out of it.[n]Technology has truly come a long way.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That settles it. I'll go with that one,[n]then.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: With such revolutionary techology,[n]I may be driven to create innovative[n]new stratagems.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm glad I was able to assist.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If I might ask—what do you plan to do[n]with your old electric fan? I would be[n]happy to take it off your hands...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Another acquaintance of yours? You're[n]very well-connected, [lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, if it isn't Mifune-san. She's an[n]accomplished fortune teller.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Fascinating. What kinds of fortunes[n]does she tell?
Money.[clr 27]
Luck.[clr 27]
She knows everything.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now that sounds like a useful fortune.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I've always wondered why I'm always[n]plagued by financial woes. I suspect it's[n]karma for some offense in a past life.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry. Without my tarot cards,[n]I'm afraid I can't divine much...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But I can tell a little bit from your aura[n]alone.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That's perfect. I'd very much appreciate[n]a reading on my luck...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, I'm sorry. I can't see much of the[n]future without my tarot cards.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But I can tell a little bit from your aura[n]alone.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Not everything! And without my tarot[n]cards, I can't divine much anyway...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, but I can tell a little bit based on[n]your personal aura.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Ah, I see...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The two of you seem to bear a very[n]interesting connection with[n][lName]-san...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It's somewhat different from ordinary[n]friendship... I sense quite an unusual[n]bond indeed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see... Well, you aren't wrong there.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes, that sounds about right.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You really are a mysterious person.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Their stars burn with such intensity...[n]What strange destiny could draw them[n]together?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: By the way, Mifune-san, why are you[n]here?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh, right. I was looking for a replacement[n]for my old electric fan.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I know the worst of the heat is past, but[n]I can't make it through these Tokyo[n]summers without one.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: What a coincidence—that's what I was[n]looking for, too. These two were just[n]helping me decide what model to buy.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: My goodness! Another strange[n]coincidence...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps the fates conspired to put us[n]all here. Now we can peruse the bladeless[n]fans together, yes?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Huh? Bladeless?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Haha, how is a fan supposed to blow air[n]with no blades? I'm not THAT gullible.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Seeing is believing. Shall we go inspect[n]it for ourselves?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Whuh... What in tarnation!?
